locator.section: De musica sacra et sacra liturgia 25 b, 26 and 31 c

entries.claim: The faithful may sing Agnus Dei with the Ordinary at the second participation degree, also at Missa cantata. At low Mass they may recite it with the celebrant at the third degree. This permission neither asserts actual congregational participation nor replaces the celebrant’s distinct recitation.
